digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync and outbound field diffing
propositions: Two live cells never passed across 12 consecutive harness runs because they were wrong oracles asserting operations the DC platform cannot perform, not regressions or rebar defects.

DC 8.17.1 silently ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task and rejects parent nulling with 400, but reparents succeed via the Epic Link field on non-sub-task children, making the latter the supported mechanism.

emit-side parent suppression for non-epic shapes returned (False, None) byte-identical to unbound-retry (False, None), making the suppression indistinguishable from retry and leaving record_parent_divergence unreachable when a user's parent edit diverged from the tracker.

The three failing cells were re-homed to supported shapes (Epic Link for non-sub-task children) with their original user-visible assertions preserved, and the silent-drop defect was fixed by recording suppressed non-epic parents to dropped_field_sink when they diverge from the tracker.
